produced_by.game: From TV Animation One Piece: Treasure Wars 2 - Welcome to Buggy Land
produced_by.notes:
**From TV Animation One Piece: Treasure Wars 2 - Welcome to Buggy Land** is Bandai's 2002 One Piece board game for the WonderSwan Color, released only in Japan. Buggy has opened a pirate amusement park, Buggy Land, and invites Luffy's crew and a crowd of other characters to play the "Treasure Wars": roll the dice across the park's attractions, collect hints, steal treasures and keys with Actions and items, and hold the treasure when the Log is full. Story mode follows the crew through the attractions up to Buggy Castle; there are also Party (up to 4 players on one Swan), Teach (tutorial), Bingo Book and Link modes.

The translation comes in two versions with the same English text: **normal** (upper and lower case) and **ALL CAPS**. Both are made from the same Japanese ROM; pick the one you prefer.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like). It isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.
